content: Clone repo & enumerate all branches with metadata (SHA, date, author, message, merge-base)
Inspect main branch: HEAD SHA, structure, stack, docs, logs, patches
Inspect every conflict branch: tree, stack, project identity, classification
Read all handoffs, agent logs, roadmaps, patches, test reports across branches
Audit auth/RBAC & search for test bypasses (X-Patient-Id, skip auth, etc.)
Assess Provider Portal, Client Portal, Admin Portal feature status
Build current-state matrix, approved-build synopsis, chronology
Produce final Neo Entry Report deliverable
